title: Microkernel architecture evaluation and documentation + Next.js CVE fix
body:
Comprehensive evaluation of ObjectStack's microkernel architecture and package distribution. Added architectural documentation for the 12-package, 6-layer system.

## Documentation Added

- **ARCHITECTURE.md** (661 lines) - Microkernel design, plugin system, dependency graph, design decisions
- **PACKAGE-DEPENDENCIES.md** (313 lines) - 6-layer hierarchy, build order, dependency rules, DAG validation
- **QUICK-REFERENCE.md** (253 lines) - Developer quick reference with code examples, common tasks, testing patterns

## Documentation Updated

- **README.md** - Reorganized package structure into 6 categories (Core, Engines, Clients, Plugins, Tools)
- **micro-kernel.mdx** - Added ObjectQLPlugin, DriverPlugin, AppPlugin documentation with current API

## Architecture Highlights

**Package Organization** (12 packages):
```
Layer 0: @objectstack/spec (protocols, zero runtime deps)
Layer 1: @objectstack/types (shared types)
Layer 2: @objectstack/core (220-line kernel: lifecycle, DI, events)
Layer 3: @objectstack/objectql, @objectstack/runtime (engines)
Layer 4: client SDKs
Layer 5: plugins (driver-memory, plugin-hono-server, plugin-msw)
Layer 6: tools (cli, ai-bridge)
```

**Key findings**:
- Zero circular dependencies (strict DAG)
- Protocol-first design (Zod schemas)
- Minimal external dependencies (@objectstack/spec: only zod; @objectstack/core: spec, pino, zod)
- Plugin independence via service registry

## Security Fix

Updated Next.js `16.1.3` → `16.1.5` to patch DoS vulnerability in React Server Components HTTP request deserialization (CVE). Affects only `apps/docs`.

**Post-merge**: Run `pnpm install` to regenerate lockfile.

## Stats

- 1,360 lines added
- 3 new architecture guides (36.6KB)
- 7 files modified
